title: Drop the friction logs as evidence for rule changes
goal: The friction logs stop being cited as evidence; the tool and its page say what they measure
acceptance: rule-review "Measure actual friction" and the places that cite the logs as evidence are changed so the logs are no longer evidence for slips or rule cost; what the log measures (reconcile and adoption time, nerv only in practice) is stated
a change-impact pass: every copy of the changed pages in the projects is listed for the next reconcile
no safeguard is removed: the evidence, ownership, privacy and safety rules stay
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
